name: Buffalo Chicken Burrito
writer_notes: STAGE2: built from burrito-stage1-builds C2. REBUILT from the source's ground chicken onto diced and shredded chicken breast. This is a fidelity improvement, since classic buffalo chicken is shredded breast, not ground. Ground chicken is banned this batch and appears nowhere, including asides.
S2 owns this recipe: the buffalo cottage sauce is blended cottage cheese plus shredded cheddar plus buffalo wing sauce, which carries the tang and heat without ranch-dressing calories.
Carrot and celery are the buffalo-wing plate in vegetable form, cooked into the filling rather than served on the side.

Differs from the live Slow Cooker Buffalo Chicken and Rice Bowl by cut (diced and shredded breast), by the blended cottage sauce, and by the tortilla format. Selection notes this is a tight fit under the 400 cap, not a headroom recipe.
Buffalo Wing Sauce is 0 cal per the DB label, so the heat is free on the macro sheet.
intro_html: Buffalo chicken done the way the sports bar wishes it could. We poach and shred lean chicken breast, cook it down with onion, carrot and celery so the whole wing-night plate ends up inside the wrap, and bind it with a blended cottage cheese and cheddar sauce spiked with buffalo wing sauce. No ranch, no blue cheese pour, no deep fryer. Each burrito comes in under 400 calories with 4 ounces of meat and {{protein}} grams of protein, on a high fiber tortilla that keeps you at about 5 grams of net carb. We have a Slow Cooker Buffalo Chicken and Rice Bowl already; this is the handheld version, built on shredded breast and a creamy cottage sauce instead of rice.
ingredients_display: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast (Member's Mark): 3.5 lb (1582 g)
cost_note_html: Real Omaha store prices from our weekly grocery board (2026). They still swing by store and by what is on sale.
cost_lines: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast, 3.5 lb: ~$7.78. Buy 4 lbs: $8.92.
Buffalo Wing Sauce, 6.5 tbsp: ~$0.67. Buy 1 (lasts several batches).
Pantry seasonings (salt, black pepper): ~$0.10. From jars you keep on hand.

Batch total: about $27.85 across 14 servings, so roughly $1.99 per burrito. This counts only the amounts this batch actually uses from each package, so it is the cost of the food in the containers, not a register receipt.

True shopping cost: about $35.85 across 14 servings, roughly $2.56 per burrito. What the register trip looks like if your pantry is already stocked. Meat, produce, and packaged items are counted as the whole packages you have to buy, since you cannot grab a partial box, can, or jar. Pantry staples you already own (rice, seasonings, oils, and long-lasting sauces) are counted at only what this batch uses.

Starting with an empty pantry? Add about $11.57 one time. That is the extra cost of buying full containers of every pantry staple in this recipe instead of just the amounts used, which puts a first shopping trip near $47.42. Those containers then feed this batch and many more after it.
cost_closing_html: About ${{cost_ps}} a burrito (at everyday cost) for wing night without the wings, the fryer, or the guilt. The cottage sauce is the trick that keeps it both creamy and lean.
shop_smart: Chicken breast is the whole game here, so buy it in the big family pack and freeze what this batch does not use. Shredded breast reheats better than diced, so cook it low and pull it apart.
Cottage cheese blends into a sauce that does the job of ranch and blue cheese for a fraction of the fat. Buy the tub and blend it smooth.
Carrots and celery are cheapest as whole bunches and bags, not the pre-cut snack packs, and this batch uses a good amount of both.
Buffalo wing sauce keeps for months in the door of the fridge, so buy the bottle and let it ride through several batches.
make_it: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Season the chicken breast with the salt and black pepper, then poach or bake it until cooked through and shred it with two forks.
Warm the olive oil in a large skillet and cook the diced onion, carrot and celery for 8 to 10 minutes until soft and sweet.
Add the shredded chicken to the pan and warm it through with the vegetables.
Blend the cottage cheese, shredded cheddar and buffalo wing sauce until smooth, then stir the sauce into the warm chicken so every shred is coated.
Set the bowl on the scale, subtract the empty weight, and divide by 14. Lay that much filling down each tortilla, fold in the sides and roll tight.
Wrap each burrito and portion into 14 containers.
portion_html: Weigh the finished filling, subtract the empty bowl, and divide by 14 so every burrito gets the same load of chicken and sauce. Fill, fold and roll each tortilla. Each burrito carries {{cal}} calories and {{protein}} grams of protein. Reheat wrapped, then crisp the seam in a dry pan if you want the edges to hold.

steps: Season and cook the chicken breast, then shred it.
Cook onion, carrot and celery in olive oil until soft, then warm the chicken through.
Blend cottage cheese, cheddar and buffalo wing sauce and stir it into the chicken.
Weigh the filling, divide by 14, fill and roll each tortilla, and portion into 14 containers.
